sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: Candidate faithfully encodes the ship-scoped conditional requirement: it preserves the true/false applicability alternatives, requires PST and required-system functionality only when applicable, constrains both quantities to Celsius QuantityValue nodes, and checks PST <= lowest MDLT - 10 using formula-result-scaled tolerance with permitted piecewise arithmetic. No semantic, ownership, datatype, unit, vocabulary, or SHACL defects remain.

sheets.name: ITERATIONS
rows: Repair the derived temperature comparison: the SPARQL check currently uses an exact FILTER (?pstValue > (?lowestValue - 10)) with no formula-result-scaled tolerance. Encode the expected result as lowestMdlt minus 10 and apply the permitted tolerance scaled from that expected formula result, never from the reported PST value; retain the existing <= direction, applicability alternatives, ship ownership, Celsius units, and true functional-status requirement.

Preserve the existing applicability alternatives, ship ownership, Celsius quantity constraints, <= comparison direction, expected result lowestMdlt minus 10, formula-scaled tolerance, and required functional-status check. Repair the DIRECT_CALCULATION SPARQL tolerance expression by replacing unsupported ABS(...) calls with permitted simple piecewise arithmetic branches (for example, IF(value >= 0, value, -value)); DIRECT_CALCULATION permits simple piecewise branches but not ABS as an unregistered operation.

Candidate faithfully encodes the ship-scoped conditional requirement: it preserves the true/false applicability alternatives, requires PST and required-system functionality only when applicable, constrains both quantities to Celsius QuantityValue nodes, and checks PST <= lowest MDLT - 10 using formula-result-scaled tolerance with permitted piecewise arithmetic. No semantic, ownership, datatype, unit, vocabulary, or SHACL defects remain.
